Game Overview

In Tuu Bot, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling journey in Tuu Bot, a 2D platformer set in a futuristic universe. Navigate through eight exhilarating levels while dodging hostile robots and traps. Master precision, leverage double jumps, and outsmart cunning adversaries as the game's intensity keeps pushing your skills to the edge.
